Looking at packages/ui/index.tsx, the diff shows 'export { default as MultiEmail } from "./form/MultiEmailLazy"' is being added. MultiEmailLazy imports MultiEmail.tsx dynamically. So the chain is: MultiEmail.tsx imports from @calcom/ui (barrel) -> barrel exports MultiEmail from MultiEmailLazy -> MultiEmailLazy imports MultiEmail.tsx. This creates a circular dependency. The import 'import { Button, EmailField, Icon, Tooltip } from "@calcom/ui"' in MultiEmail.tsx should use relative imports instead to avoid this circular reference.
